expressions.name: Transformative Liberation
expressions.shortDescription: Power is redistributed, equitable practices become embedded, and transformation is sustained through shared leadership, accountability, and continual learning.
expressions.leadershipImpact: You are positioned to create lasting, equity-centered transformation by redistributing power, strengthening accountability, and helping to embed equitable practices in the way people and organizations learn, lead, and evolve.
expressions.deepeningPractice: To further expand your influence, continue building systems that develop other leaders, distribute responsibility, and embed equity into everyday organizational practice so that transformation continues beyond your direct influence.

expressions.name: Regenerative Stability
expressions.shortDescription: Systems become stronger through increased trust, healthier relationships, and more equitable practices, creating a stable foundation for continued transformation.
expressions.leadershipImpact: Your leadership is building healthier systems by fostering trust, stability, and thoughtful improvement while creating opportunities to expand shared leadership and collective ownership.
expressions.deepeningPractice: Building on this foundation, intentionally expand opportunities for shared leadership by broadening participation in decision-making and increasing collective ownership of organizational priorities.

expressions.name: Performative Change
expressions.shortDescription: Energy and momentum generate visible change, but without meaningful shifts in power, transformation remains difficult to sustain.
expressions.leadershipImpact: You bring energy and momentum for change, creating opportunities to strengthen how power, voice, and decision-making are shared across your organization.
expressions.deepeningPractice: Your next opportunity is to redesign structures, governance, and accountability so that changes in practice are accompanied by meaningful shifts in power and influence.

expressions.name: Stagnation
expressions.shortDescription: Existing patterns continue to shape outcomes, highlighting opportunities to build greater awareness, shared responsibility, and readiness for transformation.
expressions.leadershipImpact: Your greatest contribution lies in providing the stability and consistency that can serve as the foundation for intentionally reshaping systems and advancing more equitable outcomes.
expressions.deepeningPractice: One way to strengthen your leadership is to examine one long-standing practice through an equity lens, inviting diverse perspectives and creating opportunities for shared reflection that open new pathways for organizational change.
